notes.content: [h3][b]Improvements[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Settings menu[/b] now works properly both in the main menu and in-game builds.[/p][/*][*][p]Graphics settings expanded: [b]V-Sync, Quality Levels, and FPS Cap[/b] added.[/p][/*][*][p]Resolution dropdown cleaned up - Hz values moved elsewhere to avoid duplicates.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Mouse sensitivity[/b] now displays as a whole number instead of “100,00”.[/p][/*][*][p]Wardrobe camera can be rotated with right mouse button and resets when reopened.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed: Graphics options in builds didn’t apply in the Lobby scene.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed: Audio volume showed 10000% (math is hard for raccoons).[/p][/*][/list]

tags.feature: [p]Graphics settings expanded: [b]V-Sync, Quality Levels, and FPS Cap[/b] added.[/p]
